tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen; also the 'What you pasted' quote panel inside a card, evidence quote boxes and the privacy note on desktop.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, secondary buttons, the active segment, the no-warning verdict fill.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, inert URL chips, tags, row dividers inside cards, the mobile privacy note.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, header rule, progress-bar track, chip borders on ground. Decorative hairline (1.3:1 on ground): never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Text-area border and neutral chip border. Below 3:1 on surface (1.7:1) in the source: kept exact; the field's label and fill carry the affordance.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Secondary-button border. 1.8:1 on surface in the source: kept exact; the brand-coloured label carries the affordance.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on ground, surface, sunken and every verdict tint (13:1+).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, lead paragraphs, inactive segments, list bodies. On ground, surface and sunken (6.6:1+).

tokens.name: caption
tokens.usage: Captions, counters, step labels, module meta, URL scheme and path. On ground, surface and sunken (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: eyebrow
tokens.usage: Uppercase label text ('Your input', 'What you pasted'). On ground and surface (5.7:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, links, brand monogram, active participant chip, selected option border, progress fill. As text on ground and surface (8.5:1+).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover colour.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: 'Me' message bubble; icon well of the selected input option. Ink and brand both read on it (7.6:1+).

tokens.name: on-brand-mark

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: Glass card edge. Never carries status or control meaning by itself.
